description: The plot compares the maximum activation value across different layers for various components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 23 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 1600 with tick labels at intervals of 200. The plot displays four lines: "attn_output" in blue with a dashed line style, which remains steady around 30 across the x-axis; "attn_residual" in orange with a dotted line style, which starts at around 30, sharply increases to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains high until layer 21, and then decreases; "ffn_output" in green with a dash-dot line style, which begins at around 30, shows fluctuations with peaks at layers 6, 13, and 23, reaching values of approximately 500, 450, and 1200 respectively; and "ffn_residual" in red with a solid line style, which starts at around 30, sharply increases to about 1450 at layer 5, remains relatively stable until layer 21, and then drops to around 400 at layer 23.
